summary_en: The caller stated they were busy and requested to be called back later. The agent acknowledged the request and asked for a preferred day or time for the callback. The caller did not specify a particular time, saying only that they wanted to be contacted sometime later. After a brief back-and-forth, the caller agreed and ended the call by saying goodbye. The agent confirmed that the caller's details and the request for a follow-up call were saved.
next_action: Agent to arrange a callback at a later unspecified time.
objections: Caller stated they were busy and did not want to talk at that moment.

lead_assessment.note: Priority score uses recorded business signals; it is not a conversion probability or contact consent.
